name: Names of Power
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue of name magic; Names of Power add bonuses to Casting Score for spells matching their scope, limited by Magic Theory.

name: Invocation Magic
description: Major Mystery Virtue requiring Names of Power, letting a magus cast Names of Power as Muto Vim spells to boost a following spellcasting, limited by Magic Theory.

name: Hermetic Theurgy
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue teaching how to invent Invoke spells that form pacts with specific named spirits.

name: Theurgic Spirit Familiar
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue essentially identical to Spirit Familiar but part of name magic; a powerful maga may bind an Aspect of a Daimon as familiar.

name: Spirit Familiar
description: Virtue from Chapter 8 (Spirit Magic) allowing a spirit to be bound as a familiar; a spirit familiar automatically stays with an ascending magus.

name: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
aliases: Mystery Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
description: Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue requiring Hermetic Theurgy, teaching a path of apotheosis by which a hierarch ascends as a Daimon to the Hall of Heroes with the aid of celebrants.

name: Hermetic Synthemata
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue teaching how to research a being's synthemata as spells that boost Penetration against it.

name: Synthemata Magia
description: Major Supernatural Mystery Ability, the non-Hermetic predecessor of Hermetic Synthemata, letting a magus intuit a being's synthemata using (Realm) Lore.

name: Great Talisman
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue letting a magus attune his talisman's Shape and Material Bonuses more easily and add new components to it.

name: Consummate Talisman
description: Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue allowing Muto Vim effects and Names of Power to be enchanted into a talisman to affect the magus's own spellcasting.

name: Inscription on the Soul
description: Spirit Magic Mystery (Chapter 8) letting a magus use body or spirit as talisman; it can substitute for Great Talisman as prerequisite to Consummate Talisman.

name: Faerie Magic
description: Virtue linking a magus to the Faerie realm, allowing him to invent spells summoning faerie spirits.

name: Flexible Formulaic Magic
description: Virtue allowing a caster to vary one of Range, Duration or Target by one step; invoked spirits cast as if they had it.

name: Slow Caster
description: Flaw causing instructing an invoked spirit to take two rounds rather than one.

name: Life-Boost
description: Virtue requiring expenditure of Fatigue; a Daimon expends Might instead.

name: Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
description: Virtue involving Fatigue expenditure for spontaneous magic; Daimonic magi pay 5 Might per Fatigue level instead.

name: Deleterious Circumstances
description: Flaw gained as a Minor Ordeal for Consummate Talisman: magic totals halved when not touching the talisman.

name: Necessary Condition
description: Major Ordeal Flaw that may be taken for Consummate Talisman: the magus must wield his talisman or his magic fails.

name: Second Sight
description: Magical sense able to see the magical circle of an Arcane Circle or Arcane Ring (Ease Factor 9).

name: Hermetic Numerology
description: Minor Mystery Virtue letting a magus devise Rotes and enchant a Numerologist's Book; prerequisite for Divination (Numerology).

name: Hermetic Geometry
description: Minor Mystery Virtue using Euclid's postulates for sympathetic magic, granting casting bonuses for perfect figures and new Line Range, Arcane Circle Target and Arcane Ring Duration.

name: Hermetic Architecture
description: Minor Mystery Virtue for large-scale enchantment of rooms, buildings, stone circles, paths and gateways through linked component devices, and for manipulating auras and regiones.

name: Dream Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue, synthesized from Baltic folk tradition by Raisa of Novgorod, letting a magus enter and act within dreams.

name: Celestial Magic
description: Mystery that reduces the vis requirement for opening devices by the Laboratory Horoscope score.

name: Philosophic Alchemy
description: Mystery that can pre-fill an object with opened enchantment spaces, reducing spaces a magus must open.

name: Divination (Numerology)
description: Numerological divination for which Hermetic Numerology is prerequisite; the Numerologist's Book adds to it as ceremonial bonus.

name: Casual Augury (Numerology)
description: Numerological augury used with Numbering the Flock to interpret numbers.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability limiting Name of Power bonuses, talisman components, vis handling and appearing in Lab Totals.

name: (Realm) Lore
description: Realm Lore Abilities used in theurgic Lab Totals, synthemata research and intuiting synthemata.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Liberal arts Ability; its arithmetic specialty underlies Numerology and its geometry specialty Hermetic Geometry and Architecture.

name: Profession: Scribe
description: Ability used with Dexterity to draw a perfect shape for Hermetic Geometry.

name: Concentration
description: Ability rolled to trace Circle/Ring shapes and to stay in a dream despite physical disturbance.

name: Craft
description: Craft Ability; not required to add components to a great talisman, and Verditius mysteries reduce vis by Craft Score.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique of transformation; Names of Power, synthemata and talisman effects are Muto Vim.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form of magic itself; used in synthemata, Invoke Pact rituals and aura-manipulating enchantments.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique of creation; Transformation of the Ascendant Hierarch and aura-increasing enchantments are Creo Vim.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique of control; used in Invoke the Pact of (Daimon), Bind the Mystical Structure and geometry spells.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique of perception; used in Numerologist's counting spells and detecting magical circles.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique of destruction; a requisite for shrinking regiones and imperfecting shapes.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire; Pilum of Fire and Numera's Rotes are Creo Ignem.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form of earth; Rego Terram geometry guidelines reshape dirt and stone.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form of plants, a requisite in building-perfecting spells.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form of the human body; used in counting people and in dream spell examples.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form of animals; Numbering the Flock is InAn.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form of mind; the capacity to dream is a function of Mentem, and Mentem magic enters or controls dreams.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form of images; the substance of dreams, and all magic within dreams is cast as Imaginem.

name: Invoke the Spirit of (spell)
description: Generic Mystery spell forming a pact with a named spirit that casts a single Formulaic spell as a power on the magus's behalf.

name: Invoke the Spirit of (Form)
description: Generic Mystery spell forming a pact with a named spirit that performs effects as if casting Spontaneous Magic in a given Art combination.

name: Invoke the Pact of (Daimon)
description: ReVi Mystery Ritual forming a pact with a powerful named Daimon, which sends an Aspect to answer and perform services; grants the Daimon Daimon Points.

name: Invoke the Spirit Akkala for a Day
description: Gunnar's CrIg 30 Invoke spell summoning the spirit Akkala until sunset to cast Pilum of Fire.

name: Invoke the Spirit Nissila
description: Gunnar's Invoke spell with 15 added levels for a +30 Penetration bonus, summoning Nissila to cast Pilum of Fire.

name: Pilum of Fire
description: Level 20 Creo Ignem spell that Gunnar's invoked spirits Akkala and Nissila can cast for him.

name: Wizard's Communion
description: Spell used by groups of magi to aid Penetration, e.g. when casting Invoke Pact or Transformation of the Ascendant Hierarch.

name: Ascendant Form of the Intendant Hierarch
description: Mystery Ritual in which the hierarch constructs a prototype ascendant form, manifesting his abilities in their strongest form during apotheosis.

name: Transformation of the Ascendant Hierarch
description: CrVi Mystery Ordeal Ritual cast by celebrants on a hierarch under Ascendant Form, accumulating transformation points toward ascension.

name: Synthemata of (X)
description: MuVi Mystery spell unique to one named being, adding its level to the caster's Penetration for the next spell against that being.

name: The Lasting Synthemata of (X)
description: Diameter-duration MuVi Mystery synthemata spell adding (level-5) to Penetration for all spells against the named being while it lasts.

name: The Hedge Lord's Synthemata of (X)
description: MuVi spell from Synthemata Magia adding (level-5) to Casting Score against the named being for two minutes.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Covenant ward spell that may ward out a spirit offended by synthemata research.

name: Enchantment of the Scrying Device
description: Effect that can be invested into a Numerologist's Book to give a Magical bonus to Ceremonial Divination.

name: Numbering the Flock
description: InAn 20 spell letting the Numerologist instantly know the number and kinds of animals she can see.

name: The Significance of the Group
description: InCo 10 spell that divines the number of people in a group, with any Group restriction.

name: Numbering the Host
description: InCo 15 spell revealing the number of people the caster can see, distinguished by appearance.

name: Scribe the Perfect Circle
description: Re(Cr)Te 4 spell that scribes a perfect circle for a magus to trace for circle spells.

name: Perfection of the Well-Designed Chamber
description: Re(Cr)Te(He) 20 spell reshaping one room of a building to be perfectly regular for Hermetic Geometry ceremonial bonuses.

name: The Perfected Structure
description: Re(Cr)Te(He) 20 spell reshaping an entire building to be geometrically perfect, stronger and more pleasing.

name: Bind the Mystical Structure
description: ReVi Mystery Ritual linking the component devices of a Hermetic Architecture enchantment into one working whole.

name: The Lucid Dreamer
description: Mu(In)Me 20 Mystery spell letting the caster's conscious spirit enter his own dream and act freely.

name: Agathocles' Recipe for Sending a Dream
description: Spell on a Gnostic papyrus showing early heretics experimented with dream magic.

name: The Perfected Tower
description: Re(Cr)Te(He) 34 Hermetic Architecture enchantment using seven component devices to keep a stone tower perpetually perfected.

name: Trajan's Arena
description: CrMe 25 Hermetic Architecture enchantment by Trajan of Tytalus using eight stone pillars to make combatants in an arena fight in berserk rage.

name: Increase of the Room's Modest Aura
description: CrVi 84 Mystery enchantment increasing a room's Magical aura by +1 to a maximum of 5.

name: Bountiful Boundary's Splendid Aura
description: CrVi 99 Mystery enchantment increasing the Magical aura in a Boundary by +1 to a maximum of 6.

name: Enchantment of the Magnified Regio
description: MuVi(Te) 39 Mystery enchantment doubling the size of a Magical regio up to 200 paces across.

name: Closed Privacy of the Enchanted Regio
description: Mu(Pe)Vi(Te) 79 Mystery enchantment shrinking a regio's interface until it pinches off, closing the regio.

name: Conjunction of the Mystic Veils
description: Re(Mu)Vi 45 Mystery enchantment creating a password-opened gateway between two levels of a magical regio, typically as two pillars.

name: Numerologist's Book
description: Enchanted book attuned to Numerological magic, lesser (+4) or greater (+8), adding a book bonus to Numerology, Rotes, Geometry and Architecture.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's personal enchanted item, a direct expression of his Gift, which can be attuned to Shape and Material Bonuses.

name: Brass Head
description: Famous enchanted device built by Albertus Magnus and rumored smashed by Thomas Aquinas.

name: De Theoria Magica
description: Bonisagus' authority on Magic Theory, often chosen as the basis of a Numerologist's Book.

name: Bible
description: Great work often chosen by Numerologists as the basis of their study.

name: Greater Dream Grimoire
description: Mystery source for entering bodily into dreams and bringing physical travelers into dream.

name: Gunnar of Ex Miscellanea
description: Example theurgist magus who invokes the spirits Akkala and Nissila to cast Pilum of Fire.

name: Akkala
description: Named spirit of Might 20 (named after a place in Finland) that casts Pilum of Fire for Gunnar.

name: Nissila
description: Second Pilum of Fire spirit invoked by Gunnar with high Penetration.

name: Gloria
description: Example maga selected by her cult to ascend to the Hall of Heroes via Ascendant Form and Transformation rituals.

name: Servus
description: Gloria's most senior follower, who invents the Transformation ritual for her.

name: Simon Magus
description: Father of Gnosticism, who professed to believe he had attained godhood.

name: Dolorosa
description: Example maga who makes a staff talisman with multiple components.

name: Albertus Magnus
description: Learned divine said to have built the Brass Head.

name: Thomas Aquinas
description: Pupil of Albertus Magnus rumored to have smashed the Brass Head; became the greatest theologian of the medieval Church.

name: Pythagoras
description: Ancient figure from whose time the magic of numbers has fascinated men.

name: Euclid
description: Ancient philosopher-wizard whose geometric postulates underlie Hermetic Geometry.

name: Numera
description: Example Numerologist maga who invents and casts Creo Ignem Rotes.

name: Lineus
description: Example magus who casts a Line Range spell at Centrus beyond a wall.

name: Centrus
description: Target in the Line Range example who creeps round the wall to Lineus.

name: Trajan of Tytalus
description: Magus who constructs an arena making combatants fight in berserk rage.

name: Julia of Jerbiton
description: Example maga who enchants stone columns to increase her covenant's aura and close its regio.

name: Alyssa
description: Example maga who enlarges a small magical regio for her mystery rites.

name: Raisa of Novgorod
description: Maga who in the early tenth century synthesized Baltic dream folk tradition into Hermetic Dream Magic.

name: St. John Chrysostom
description: Fourth-century saint who heeded divine dreams but denounced those working magic through dreams.

name: Bonisagus
description: Author of De Theoria Magica, the authority on Magic Theory.

name: Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House of Gunnar, the example theurgist.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House of Trajan.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House of Julia.

name: House Verditius
description: House whose magi forge items from raw materials; the Mysteries of Verditius reduce vis requirements by Craft Score.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Order, which uses 'talisman' in the Arabic sense of an item expressing magical power.

name: Gnostic Philosophers of Rome
description: Group favoring Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes as a path to immortality.

name: Knights of the Holy Stone
description: Cult whose members often choose heraldically charged shields as talismans.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Cults teaching Mysteries; pagan name-magic cults favor apotheosis.

name: Eastern Church
description: Holds that people are not responsible for their dreams but should feel shame for sinful ones.

name: Western Church
description: Church familiar with dream magics.

name: Gnosticism
description: Heretical movement founded by Simon Magus; Gnostic papyri contain dream magic.

name: Daimon
description: Intelligent, powerful unique spirit that sends Aspects into the world; ascended magi become Daimons.

name: Daimonic Aspect
description: A fraction of a Daimon sent into the mortal world, an independent spirit with its own Might pool that cannot be bound or permanently changed.

name: Ghost
description: Spirits of the dead; disembodied Aspects are like ghosts, and ghosts manifest through dreams.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings; middle- and low-rank demons reputedly make their names easy to discover.

name: Hedge wizard
description: Non-Hermetic magician; Gunnar faces an angry one in town.

name: Spirit
description: Minor spirits of Mythic Europe summoned by Invoke spells to cast spells as powers.

name: Hall of Heroes
description: Place of power of Daimons and remnant pagan pantheon, perhaps beyond the Lunar Sphere, to which apotheosis leads.

name: Lunar Sphere
description: Celestial sphere beyond which the Hall of Heroes may lie.

name: Finland
description: Land containing Akkala, a place name borrowed for the spirit Akkala.

name: Novgorod
description: City with a peasant tradition of visiting others in dreams; home of Raisa.

name: Rome
description: Ancient Rome had systems of dream incubation; home of the Gnostic Philosophers.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting, filled with minor spirits and architectural constructs.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Magic; spirits default to Magic Might and Magical auras can be boosted by Hermetic Architecture.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm of Faerie, with faerie auras and chaotic dream realms associated with fairies.

name: Divine Realm
description: The Divine, with Divine auras and dreams sent by God.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Realm of the Infernal; a dream hell-pit has an Infernal aura.

name: Dominion
description: Divine influence exemplified by the great gothic cathedrals.

name: Apotheosis
description: Process of a hierarch ascending to join the pagan gods in the Hall of Heroes as a Daimon.

name: Synthemata
description: Special names, symbols and passwords of each mystical being, used to overwhelm its Magic Resistance.

name: Name hiding
description: Means by which powerful beings hide their synthemata, reducing research points; typically Might/2.

name: Daimon Points
description: Spiritual strength gained by a Daimon from Invoke Pact spells, spent to fix study, increase Might or Characteristics, or learn from other spirits.

name: Transformation points
description: Points accumulated by successful Transformation rituals toward a hierarch's ascension.

name: Daimon Summoning Points
description: Points accumulated by Invoke Pact castings toward summoning a Daimon's Aspect.

name: Hermetic Theurgy (name magic)
description: School of name magic encompassing Names of Power, Invoke spells and synthemata.

name: Rote
description: Small numerological spell-like formula cast without die roll, as with Quiet and Still Casting.

name: Gematria
description: Jewish numerological system influencing gentile variants.

name: Occult property
description: A hidden property of material not explained by its complexio, underlying attunement bonuses.

name: Complexio
description: Elemental composition of an item.

name: Shape and Material Bonuses
description: Bonuses from an item's shape and materials, attuned into talismans and used in enchantment.

name: Compound device
description: Item with multiple components opened for enchantment, used for talismans and architectural structures.

name: Line Range
description: New Hermetic Geometry Range equivalent to Sight not requiring the target be seen, needing a geometry calculation.

name: Arcane Circle
description: New Hermetic Geometry Target equivalent to Part, linking a traced circle to a remote circle.

name: Arcane Ring
description: New Hermetic Geometry Duration equivalent to Moon, linking a traced ring to a remote circle.

name: Distance Level
description: Measure of line length used as Ease Factor for Line Range calculations.

name: Ceremonial Figures
description: Hermetic Geometry use of ceremonial casting with regular figures for +3 Casting Score.

name: Ceremonial Casting
description: Casting technique allowing geometric correspondences to boost Casting Score.

name: Extended Material and Size Table
description: Table extending enchantment sizes to rooms, structures and boundaries for Hermetic Architecture.

name: Dream Duration
description: New Duration lasting for an actual dream, equivalent to Concentration.

name: Dream Target
description: New Mentem Target allowing travel into one sleeper's dream, equivalent to Individual.

name: Spiritual Dream Travel
description: Traveling into a dream as spirit, leaving body and possessions behind while it lies in trance.

name: Lucid dreaming
description: Controlling or directing one's dreams, with roots in antiquity.

name: Dream vis
description: Vis found within dreams, nearly always Imaginem, with no effect outside dreams.

name: Dream Rituals
description: Ritual magic in dreams cast spontaneously via Ceremonial Magic rules, requiring dream vis.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link used for sympathetic magic; a spirit's name serves as one, as does a traveler's link to his body.

name: Sympathetic magic
description: Magic using connections and multipliers; Euclid's postulates provide it via Geometry.

name: Lab Text
description: Laboratory text; a theurgic Lab Text fixes the named spirit, and synthemata Lab Texts are grimoires.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that summoners and synthemata must overcome.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic protective ward that travels with a dream-traveling spirit and must be manifest during ascension.

name: Penetration
description: Ability of a spell to overcome Magic Resistance; boosted by Invoke levels and synthemata.

name: Warping
description: Magical side effect; Daimonic magi are immune.

name: Twilight
description: Magical phenomenon whose effects are separate from Invocation Magic botches.

name: Botch
description: Disastrous roll; Invocation Magic botches target the magus's magic.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura modifying spirits' Casting Scores and lab totals; within dreams it is illusory.

name: Regio
description: Magical region with levels; Hermetic Architecture can enlarge, close, or connect regiones.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical substance, sacrificed to Daimons and needed to open devices.

name: Ordeal
description: Initiation hardship; Consummate Talisman imposes a Flaw as Ordeal.

name: Initiation Script
description: Script for Mystery initiation providing bonuses for Ordeals.

name: Decrepitude
description: Aging measure that increases transformation points needed for ascension.

name: Spontaneous Magic
description: Improvised Hermetic spellcasting; Rotes compare favorably to it.

name: Formulaic magic
description: Known Hermetic spells; invoked spirits cast Formulaic spells as powers.

name: Ritual magic
description: Rituals consuming vis, including Mystery Rituals such as Invoke Pact and Bind the Mystical Structure.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Mastery special abilities such as Quiet Casting and Still Casting, which Rotes benefit from.

name: The Gift
description: Magical talent expressed by a talisman; Invocation botches may affect it.

name: Familiar
description: Magical companion that may join an ascending master by sharing the ritual Ordeal.

name: Immortality
description: Goal reached by apotheosis; ascended magi become unchanging immortals.

name: Nova stella
description: New star in the heavens by which an ascended spirit announces its presence.

name: Mysteries
description: Secret initiatory lore; Hermetic Arithmetic, Geometry, Architecture and Dreams are Mysteries.

name: Hermetic Arithmetic
description: Secrets of number magic in the Arithmetic Magic chapter.

name: Gothic cathedrals
description: Great cathedrals created by architects with non-magical tools, masterpieces of the Dominion.

name: Spying on your sodales using magic
description: High crime under Hermetic law technically committed by counting magi with Intellego.

name: Talisman attunement
description: Opening a talisman to magical attunement based on its Shape and Material Bonuses.
